meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Wikipedia: fundraising banners, plus image, reference, edit-link, navbox and Main Page box controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 with headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA 1440x900), logged out, on /wiki/Bebop, /wiki/Jazz and /wiki/Main_Page of en.wikipedia.org, plus curl of the server HTML. The fixtures real.html, desktop-real.html, main.html and desktop-main.html are structural captures with text stripped.

LIVE counts on Bebop (mobile / desktop): `#centralNotice` 1/1, `#siteNotice` 1/1 (both present but empty: no fundraising campaign was running when checked, so the rule only matters during campaigns), `sup.reference` 39/39, `.mw-editsection` 15/15, `a.edit-page` 1/0 (mobile pencil), `figure[typeof^="mw:File"]` 3/3, `.infobox-image` 1/1, `img.mw-file-element` 6/11, `.sistersitebox` 1/1, `.navbox` 0/3 (the mobile skin collapses navboxes), `#catlinks` 0/1. Main Page: `#mp-itn`, `#mp-dyk`, `#mp-otd`, `#mp-tfp` 1 each on both. The `.cn-fe-banner` and `.frb` selectors in the banner rule come from the CentralNotice and fundraising banner markup used in community filter lists and were not seen live because no campaign was running; they are harmless when absent.

NOT verified: an active donation banner, logged-in pages, other language editions (the Main Page ids are English-edition ids), Minerva night mode. The original cookie, ad and app rules matched nothing on Wikipedia, which serves none of them; they are kept unchanged.
